# Menu shortcuts

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Navigation, search, and commands · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

src/ui/menu.ts `MenuItem` shortcut field (right-aligned key, `aria-keyshortcuts`); main.ts map menu takes keys from `MAP_MODE_KEYS`, the table the key handler reads

## What is missing

test comparing displayed and registered bindings; platform notation (always written as on Windows); only the map menu has items with shortcuts; Deploy app and site have no menus
